recipient_role: Recruitment inbox (named in the advert for applications)
subject: Application: Technical Officer, Rural Development (Mildura), Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Technical Officer, Rural Development role in Mildura advertised on the Lower Murray Water careers page, which asks for applications to this address.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, doing site inspections and quality checks and preparing site reports and material records. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site and regional work and open to discussing relocation to Mildura.

The advert's focus on irrigation and drainage requirements for subdivisions, with field inspections and accurate records, is the part I would most like to learn. I have not yet used GIS or worked with statutory referrals, so I would be building that knowledge on the job.

Could we arrange a short call about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
